tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-328-lybarger-rich.bio: Family law attorney practicing in Fort Bend County since 1986.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-328-rawlins-monic.bio: Presiding Judge of the 328th District Court of Fort Bend County since her 2022 election; previously a family-law solo practitioner.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-458-jaramillo-mag.name: Maggie Jaramillo
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-458-jaramillo-mag.bio: Appointed Judge of the 458th District Court; former Judge of the 400th District Court and Associate Judge of the 268th District Court.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-458-carter-tameik.name: Tameika Carter
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-458-carter-tameik.bio: Chief Assistant District Attorney in the Harris County District Attorney's Office; former presiding Judge of the 400th District Court.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-501-bell-richard.name: Richard T. Bell
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-501-bell-richard.bio: Judge of the 501st Judicial District Court by appointment since December 2025; former Associate Judge of the 387th District Court.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-501-mcgill-clayto.name: Latosha McGill Clayton
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-501-mcgill-clayto.bio: Associate Judge of the 505th Judicial District Court since 2021; former teacher and attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-502-hanna-mark.name: Mark H. Hanna
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-502-hanna-mark.bio: Judge of the 502nd District Court by appointment since December 2025; former Associate Judge of the 458th District Court and Fort Bend County assistant district attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-502-glover-tameci.name: Tamecia Glover
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-502-glover-tameci.bio: Attorney; former Associate Judge of the 400th District Court and Assistant County Attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-county-judge-wong-dani.name: Daniel Wong
tx-fort-bend-2026-county-judge-wong-dani.bio: Engineer who has led Tolunay-Wong Engineers for over 30 years.

positions.stance: Seeks to lower property tax bills by advocating a cap on appraisal hikes, auditing government waste, and protecting seniors and working families.
Aims to attract high-quality employers, grow the commercial tax base, and streamline small business permitting.
Pledges to repave neglected roads, hold developers accountable, and prioritize lasting flood control and drainage improvements.
Supports expanding skilled trades, apprenticeships, and workforce training, and aligning local education with local economic opportunities.
Supports law enforcement and first responders and aims to reduce crime "through prevention, accountability, and enforcement."

tx-fort-bend-2026-county-judge-mccoy-dex.name: Dexter L McCoy
tx-fort-bend-2026-county-judge-mccoy-dex.bio: Former Obama Administration education official and Fort Bend ISD leader who served on the Gulf Coast Workforce Development Board.

positions.stance: Wants an efficient county budget, investment in jobs, infrastructure and transportation, and a living wage requirement for county contractors.
Proposes year-round town halls, public say in spending decisions, and "zero tolerance for corruption."
Supports making voting "easier, fairer, and more secure" and county lawsuits when state or federal actions violate voting rights or local authority.
Supports early childhood education programs and partnering with unions on apprenticeship programs for trade jobs.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-1-morales-chris.name: Chris Morales
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-1-morales-chris.bio: Judge of Fort Bend County Court at Law No. 1; former Fort Bend County assistant district attorney and private-practice attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-1-murray-nireasha.name: Nireasha Murray
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-1-murray-nireasha.bio: Attorney practicing criminal, probate, education, juvenile, family, and mental health law.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-2-maljovec-jorden.name: Jorden Maljovec
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-2-maljovec-jorden.bio: Attorney with criminal defense, probate, CPS, mental health and ad litem experience; former personal injury attorney and owner of Trough Juice Bar.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-2-mccollum-tyra.name: Tyra McCollum
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-2-mccollum-tyra.bio: Presiding Judge of Fort Bend County Court at Law No. 2 since her 2022 election; former Fort Bend County assistant district attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-3-jaramillo-jessic.name: Jessica Jaramillo
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-3-jaramillo-jessic.bio: Attorney and Rosenberg City Council member.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-3-mathew-juli.name: Juli A. Mathew
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-3-mathew-juli.bio: Presiding Judge of Fort Bend County Court at Law No. 3 since 2019; former civil litigator.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-4-moore-michael.name: Michael Cody Moore
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-4-moore-michael.bio: Needville Municipal Court judge and attorney; former Fort Bend County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2, Place 2.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-4-wallace-toni.name: Toni Wallace
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-4-wallace-toni.bio: Presiding Judge of Fort Bend County Court at Law No. 4; former prosecutor and defense attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-6-hrbacek-dean.name: Dean Hrbacek
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-6-hrbacek-dean.bio: Judge of Fort Bend County Court at Law No. 6; former Sugar Land mayor and council member, tax attorney, and CPA.

tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-6-longoria-stephen.name: Stephen Longoria
tx-fort-bend-2026-ccl-6-longoria-stephen.bio: Attorney for over 32 years as a prosecutor and defense lawyer; former Fort Bend County assistant district attorney.

tx-montgomery-2026-dist-359-ghutzman-mic.name: Michael H. Ghutzman
tx-montgomery-2026-dist-359-ghutzman-mic.bio: Chief of the Major Crimes Section at the Montgomery County District Attorney's Office.

tx-montgomery-2026-county-judge-keough-m.name: Mark Keough
tx-montgomery-2026-county-judge-keough-m.bio: Montgomery County Judge since 2019; former Texas state representative, automotive industry executive, and pastor.

positions.stance: Prioritizes expanding major thoroughfares, modernizing bridges, and reducing traffic congestion, with "pay-as-you-go" planning and responsible debt management.
Seeks to keep the effective tax rate as low as possible, supports budget transparency, and opposes taxpayer-funded lobbying.
Supports funding for the Sheriff and Constables, including new deputies and higher deputy starting salaries.
Advocates "transparent, locally-verified counts" and rejecting unproven election software upgrades.
Focuses on proactive disaster mitigation, securing federal grants for drainage and debris management, and keeping the county "disaster-ready."

tx-montgomery-2026-ccl-4-hutson-echo.name: Echo Hutson
tx-montgomery-2026-ccl-4-hutson-echo.bio: Judge of Montgomery County Court at Law No. 4 since January 2023; former Montgomery County domestic violence chief prosecutor.
